facts.fact: Finn 用 Jo 给他的门禁密码自己进了 Allard 家的后门
facts.anchor: He punches in the code Jo gave him and lets himself in.

facts.fact: 屋里除了一张海滩全家福，没有任何生活痕迹
facts.anchor: Besides the immense photo of the Allards on the beach, there is no sign of actual life.

facts.fact: 狗下楼时轻微跛脚，护着左前爪
facts.anchor: Muffinhead limps slightly as he descends, favoring his front left paw.

facts.fact: 母亲有救世主情结，父亲去世后她把力气都花在狗身上而不是去修别人
facts.anchor: She had a real savior complex, and Finn was grateful she had poured that energy into dogs and not trying to fix broken men once his dad died and she was alone.

facts.fact: 信封背面印着血红色的钢笔图案和 CRIMSON EDGE 字样
facts.anchor: a bold bloodred rendering of a fountain pen and the words CRIMSON EDGE beneath it

facts.fact: Finn 想起 Aziz 警探的警告，没有拆开别人的信
facts.anchor: He is reminded of Detective Aziz’s warning not to do anything illegal

facts.fact: 他的寻人海报被撕成两半挂在电线杆上
facts.anchor: The sight of one of his flyers, ripped in half and hanging from a telephone pole, yanks him out of his thoughts.

facts.fact: Paula 承认是她把 Finn 推荐给 Allard 家
facts.anchor: The Allards. I recommended you to them.

facts.fact: 房东说这回轮到她做东办麻将局
facts.anchor: I believe it’s my turn to host mah-jongg.

facts.fact: 她教 Finn 在牌桌上闭嘴、竖着耳朵听
facts.anchor: keep your mouth shut and your ears open
